oneLiner: 把化学能转化为电能的装置，负极氧化、正极还原。
oneLinerEn: Converts chemical energy to electricity; anode oxidizes, cathode reduces.
detail: 锌铜原电池：负极 Zn−2e⁻=Zn²⁺（氧化），正极 2H⁺+2e⁻=H₂↑（还原）；电子经外电路由负到正。
detailEn: Zn–Cu cell: anode Zn−2e⁻=Zn²⁺, cathode 2H⁺+2e⁻=H₂↑; electrons flow externally from − to +.

subs.name: 锌（负极）
subs.noteEn: Oxidized by losing electrons: Zn − 2e⁻ = Zn²⁺.

subs.name: 铜离子（溶液）
subs.noteEn: Reduced at the cathode by gaining electrons.

subs.name: 锌离子
subs.note: 负极氧化进入溶液的产物。

oneLiner: 借助外加电流把电能转化为化学能的装置。
oneLinerEn: Uses external current to turn electricity into chemical change.
detail: 阳极氧化、阴极还原；电解水：阳极出 O₂、阴极出 H₂（体积比 1:2），阴阳两极得失电子数相等。
detailEn: Anode oxidizes, cathode reduces; electrolyzing water gives O₂ and H₂ in a 1:2 volume ratio with equal electrons.

subs.name: 氢气（阴极）
subs.note: 阴极还原产物，体积约为氧气两倍。
subs.noteEn: Cathode product, about twice the oxygen volume.

oneLiner: 金属被氧化而损耗，主要防止方法是隔绝或电化学保护。
oneLinerEn: Metals oxidize away; prevented by barrier or electrochemical protection.
detail: 钢铁吸氧腐蚀最常见；防护有涂镀层、改变组成（不锈钢）、牺牲阳极（接更活泼金属）与外加电流阴极保护法。
detailEn: Iron's oxygen absorption rust is common; protection includes coatings, stainless alloys, sacrificial anodes and impressed-current cathodic protection.

oneLiner: 利用电解在表面镀上金属，或提纯粗金属。
oneLinerEn: Uses electrolysis to coat surfaces or purify crude metals.
detail: 电镀：镀层金属作阳极、待镀件作阴极、含镀层离子为电解液；电解精炼铜时粗铜作阳极、纯铜作阴极。
detailEn: Plating: anode is coating metal, cathode the workpiece, electrolyte holds its ions; refining copper uses crude anode and pure cathode.

oneLiner: 电极上析出物质的量与通过的电量成正比。
oneLinerEn: Mass deposited at an electrode is proportional to charge passed.
detail: Q = It，1 mol 电子电量约 96500 C（法第常数 F）；据此由电量算析出金属的质量与气体的体积。
detailEn: Q = It with F ≈ 96500 C/mol; use charge to compute deposited mass and gas volume.
